_note: Spelling variants of a subject folded into one id: left is the variant's id, right is the subject to file it under. Applied by scripts/merge-topic-aliases.js after the backfill on every tagger run, and consulted by backfill-topic-tags.js before it creates a new subject. Mechanical variants (punctuation, a leading The, number words, a trailing case/saga, middle initials) are found automatically and do not need an entry here.
